newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Australian Foreign Minister to visit Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Australian Foreign Minister to visit Sri Lanka.

text.p: Australian Foreign Minister Alexander Downer will arrive in Sri Lanka on Wednesday on a three-day visit, government officials said on Monday.
They said Downer's visit, the first by a minister of Prime Minister John Howard's administration, was part of a tour that would take him to India, Malaysia, Brunei, Japan, and Singapore.
Downer would meet Prime Minister Sirimavo Bandaranaike, government ministers, leaders of the opposition and minority political parties, officials at the Australian High Commission in Colombo said.
Downer is expected to discuss prospects for an early end to the country's 13-year-old ethnic war.
A statement from Downer's office in Canberra quoted the minister as saying he would emphasise Australia's strong interest in seeing an early solution to the crisis.
Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels are fighting government troops for a separate homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east.
Australia has a substantial Tamil community.
